decision.Steve: Independent proposal favors immediate explicit Saved navigation and reuse of useRetryFocus. Supports after challenge/final source review. Preferred notice above panels; root verifies stable bottom placement natively. Did not rerun build/lint/native checks.
decision.Elena: Independent deferred-intent proposal; accepts immediate explicit navigation after challenge because the existing helper can guard only the later row focus. Final actual source review no blocker. Did not rerun build/lint/native checks.
decision.Morgan: Open Saved audio on explicit Review click. Keep one stable notice/button after all tab panels, preserving its manual completion position. Reuse unchanged useRetryFocus for request/take/profile/recovery-bound handoff; read mutation never navigates. Global savedTakeReview pending plus synchronous guard reject duplicates across route unmount. Confirm exact take from awaited refetch and retain completion-keyed errors. Native pending/error geometry confirms current action stays visible above player; top-placement alternative not needed in tested fixture.
